rem This file must be renamed with .bat extension before Windows will recognize it as a batch file

rem This file must be executed from within the LogicPort's installation directory due to relative paths

rem The file Quickstart.LPF must be present in its original location: <install>\Projects\Quickstart.LPF

LogicPort.exe /Load:.\Projects\Quickstart.LPF   /Acquire:1   /Export:.\Data.CSV   /Close 

rem See Data.CSV for result 

rem Some versions of Windows will write to \Users\<Current User>\AppData\Local\VirtualStore\Program Files (x86)\LogicPort

pause
